combo5.title: X-Cross Cannon into Union Controller - Triple Extra Deck Finish
combo5.description: A second X-Cross Cannon opening that trades it away with B-Buster Drake to Link Summon Platinum Gadget, then banishes Y-Yare Head and Platinum Gadget as Fusion Material for Union Controller. Union Controller and Union Hangar chain into A-Assault Core and C-Crush Wyvern, bridging through Silhouhatte Rabbit into a Tellarknight Ptolemaeus built from A-Assault Core, Z-Zillion Tank, and Y-Yare Head. Ptolemaeus is Xyz Changed up into Cyber Dragon Nova and then Cyber Dragon Infinity, while the spent Graveyard pieces are banished to pay for both Fusion Summons - ABC-Dragon Buster and XYZ-Hyper Dragon Cannon - for a three-card Extra Deck board plus a set Angel Statue - Azurune.
